en: A colorized historic postcard view from a stone staircase along a high fortification wall, looking down over a park with curving paths, lawns, trees, and a pond. Beyond the park are railway tracks, industrial buildings with chimneys, and flat countryside stretching to the horizon. A man stands by the railing in the foreground near a gas-style streetlamp. Text is printed in red at the top and right side of the image.
